# End-to-End Playwright Automation Testing Boilerplate

> Open-source, ESM TypeScript Playwright-BDD boilerplate for UI, REST, and GraphQL end-to-end testing.

Current release: `0.1.0`

## Summary

This repository uses `playwright-bdd` with Gherkin features and TypeScript source under `src/`. `bddgen` generates executable tests under `out/tests`. It includes page objects, shared Playwright actions, REST and GraphQL helpers, a typed Page-based route mocking addon, Zod contracts, environment configuration, Allure/Monocart reporting, secure sensitive-input methods, deterministic mock failure/flaky-recovery scenarios, and repository-aware Copilot agents.

## Best for

- Small to enterprise TypeScript end-to-end automation projects
- Teams adopting Gherkin/BDD with Playwright
- UI plus REST/GraphQL integration coverage
- Secure CI test execution with opt-in sensitive artifacts
- Teams using AI coding agents that need repository-specific conventions

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): installation, architecture, commands, configuration, testing, security, and limitations
- [docs/KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md](docs/KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md): framework memory and agent retrieval rules
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution workflow and validation
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security defaults and vulnerability reporting
- [playwright.config.ts](playwright.config.ts): Playwright and BDD execution configuration
- [configs/envConf.ts](configs/envConf.ts): environment endpoints and overrides
- [utilities/PlaywrightActions.ts](utilities/PlaywrightActions.ts): browser and secure-input actions
- [utilities/PlaywrightMockingAddon.ts](utilities/PlaywrightMockingAddon.ts): typed offline UI, REST, and GraphQL route mocks

## Core commands

```bash
npm ci
npx playwright install chromium
npm run typecheck
npm run test:e2e
```

## Canonical architecture

```text
src/**/features/*.feature
  -> src/**/step_definitions/*_steps.ts
  -> page objects or service wrappers
  -> shared Playwright/API/GraphQL helpers
  -> generated tests in out/tests
```

## Security

Sensitive values must come from CI secret variables or a local secret manager. Sensitive traces, screenshots, videos, HAR files, and AI prompt attachments are disabled by default.
